title: Set display sleep time when on charger
summary: Configure how long the display stays on before sleeping when the Mac is connected to a power adapter.

aliases.text: set screen timeout mac plugged in
изменить время сна экрана при зарядке

steps.explain: Use sudo pmset with the -c flag to set the display sleep timer for when the Mac is on charger power. Replace <MINUTES> with the desired number of minutes (0 means never sleep).

placeholders.name: MINUTES
placeholders.description: Number of minutes before display sleeps. 0 means never.

rollback.explain: Restore the default display sleep setting (10 minutes) for charger power.

warnings: Setting displaysleep to 0 prevents the display from turning off automatically, which may increase power consumption and screen burn-in risk.
